items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: And I played a G string melody and he'd play the variation... Louis Cantrell, drums. He was an old man by then.

ctx.x: And I played a G string melody and he'd play the variation, see. And then next course the whole band would come in there. That must have been beautiful. And what a trumpet player that Emmanuel Perez was. Strong horn, that's long. Yeah. Eddie Atkins, Louis Cantrell, Frank DeHeney. Eddie Atkins was a trombone player? Yeah. And what a trombone player. I love his work. Who else? Louis Cantrell, drums. He was an old man by then.
